scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/societe" "npm run dev --workspace apps/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/societe && npm run build --workspace apps/client
scripts.db:migrate: npm exec --workspace apps/api -- prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:push: npm exec --workspace apps/api -- prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.prisma
